title: LibKa0s v1.69.0/v1.70.0 re-vendors left unrecorded
cluster_summary: In all ten addons, LibKa0s v1.69.0 and v1.70.0 arrived as bare 'chore: re-vendor' commits that bypassed /dev-copilot:wow-revendor-libka0s. No docs/revendor bundle or register row was written, and the command's doc sync was skipped, which left v1.68.1 and kit 36 stamps in live docs. The fix is one span bundle per addon, docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/, holding only 01_DELTA.md and 05_SUMMARY.md, with line 1 exactly 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)' and base v1.68.1 given in the body. That shape is set by dev-copilot commands/wow-revendor-libka0s.md (first unrecorded tag, every tag listed). Every 05_SUMMARY reads 'carried by sweep, nothing adopted', except BankLedger's v1.70.0 line, which cites e5cd620 (Autocomplete adopted). The same commits should de-tag the stale stamps in favour of the CLAUDE.md provenance line. No upstream fix makes the per-repo bundles unnecessary, but the next LibKa0s release sweep must run through the re-vendor command so this does not recur a fourth time.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed: 5075fd5/4c16982 vendored v1.69.0/v1.70.0, and the newest bundle is 2026-10-04-v1.68.1. The audit's v1.68.1-v1.70.0 shape contradicts the command spec (span names only the unrecorded tags, first included). This is a cheap MUST record repair that otherwise recurs in every audit.
verdicts.remediation: Write docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ with only 01_DELTA.md (line 1 exactly 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)'; base v1.68.1, commits 5075fd5 and 4c16982, and the two listing commands in the body) and 05_SUMMARY.md ('v1.69.0: carried by sweep, nothing adopted' / 'v1.70.0: carried by sweep, nothing adopted'). In the same change, de-tag the stale 'v1.68.1' stamp at docs/testing.md:170. That stamp is also AT-80, so coordinate and do not double-fix.
